P = practice(); lab2i = {l:i for i,l in enumerate(LABELS)}

C12 = np.load('pass_4/cls_hidden_L12.npy').astype(np.float64); PO = np.load('pass_4/pooled.npy').astype(np.float64)
M8 = np.load('pass_2/mean_hidden_L8.npy').astype(np.float64)
Zn = (M8 - M8.mean(1,keepdims=True))/M8.std(1,keepdims=True)
print('max diff cls12 vs LN(mean8):', np.abs(C12-Zn).max(), ' pooled range', PO.min(), PO.max())
def cv_acc(X, y, lam, reps=4, std=True):
    n,d = X.shape; accs=[]
    for r in range(reps):
        perm = np.random.default_rng(r).permutation(n); folds = np.array_split(perm, 5)
        c=0
        for f in folds:
            tr = np.setdiff1d(np.arange(n), f)
            mu = X[tr].mean(0); sd = X[tr].std(0)+1e-6 if std else np.ones(d)
            Xt = (X[tr]-mu)/sd; Xv = (X[f]-mu)/sd
            Y = np.eye(8)[y[tr]]
            Wt = np.linalg.solve(Xt.T@Xt + lam*np.eye(d), Xt.T@(Y-Y.mean(0)))
            c += ((Xv@Wt).argmax(1)==y[f]).sum()
        accs.append(c/n)
    return round(np.mean(accs),4)
print('pooled std', [cv_acc(PO,y,lam) for lam in [100,200,400]])
print('pooled nostd (scaled by 1/0.1)', [cv_acc(PO/0.1,y,lam,std=False) for lam in [100,200,400]])
